title: Reggie Leaks Cenat DMs: streamer says ‘cry for help’ was ignored; Fanum urges mental reset
summary_full: Reggie, also known as Lil Rodney Son, shared screenshots of messages he sent to Kai Cenat after saying he needed to speak with him privately. He also posted a long message from Fanum, who encouraged him to step away from online pressure and keep going. The posts came after Reggie’s recent videos about his personal struggles and Clover Boys fallout.
